reel:
Your dad never borrowed ₹1. He just signed as your home loan guarantor. Stop paying your EMI and the bank can call him.
In Indian law a guarantor owes exactly what the borrower owes, and his credit score falls with yours.
Full story on YouTube: what really happens when you miss your EMI, day by day.
Has anyone in your family ever signed as a guarantor? Tell me in the comments.
#whatif #emi #loanguarantor
short:
Stop paying your EMI and the bank's clock starts that same night. Here is what happens on day 1, day 30, day 31 and day 91.
By RBI rules, recovery calls only come between 8 AM and 7 PM. Your credit report keeps the record for at least 7 years. After 91 days, your home loan becomes an NPA.
Full story on YouTube, with the twist about a paper you signed on day 1.
If your EMI bounced tomorrow, who would you call first? Tell me in the comments.
#whatif #emi #homeloan
